messages:
Ana: FYI team — planning a short maintenance window tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC for us-west2 rack A3. We've seen a thermal hotspot and want to do a graceful IO-throttle + tenant rotation to avoid sudden preempts. This targets shared pools only; dedicated pools excluded.

Sam: What's the rough plan and risk?

Ana: Plan: cordon a small cohort, rotate tenants off in small batches, apply IO throttle on the cohort to prevent IO storms, reboot GPUs only if temperature doesn't settle, then uncordon after KV-cache seeding/backfill. Expect small p99 blips (<2%) but no full-customer outage.

Leah: Capacity check — us-west2 shared is at ~75% GPU util. We can safely accept ~6 GPUs worth of rotations concurrently before queueing. Recommend batch-size 8 with concurrency 2 and an 8m stagger between batches.

Mike: Confirm dedicated pools are out of scope? We can't move reserved enterprise tenants.

Ana: Confirmed — exclude dedicated-* and regulatory-tagged tenants. Target pools: shared-saturn, shared-zephyr, burst-interruptible.

Sam: Can we prioritize background/batch jobs first and interactive last to minimize UX impact?

Leah: Yes. We'll feed the scheduler priority: background > batch > interactive and produce a tenant-priority list for the run.

Mike: Rollback criteria? If p99 >10% or error rate spikes, we should stop.

Ana: Rollback steps: pause ops job, uncordon cohort, remove throttle. I'll open rollback ticket and tag @oncall. Quick commands: ./ops job pause JOB-6170001111; ./infra uncordon --region us-west2 --rack A3 --cohort 7; curl -X POST https://infra.api/ops/throttle -d '{"cohort":"A3-7","io_pct":0}'

infra-bot: Maintenance job created: JOB-6170001111-IO-ROTATE (start 6170001100, 60m window). Watch ops dashboard.

Sam: Finance note — any estimated cost bump from overlap/backfill?

Leah: Expect ~3% extra GPU-hours for the window, ballpark $3k-$5k depending on retries. Will post final after run.

Mike: I'll run the canary and monitor p99 and GPU temps. If temp doesn't drop after two cohorts, escalate to hardware.

deploy-bot: Deploy lock scheduled for us-west2 cohorts 00:20-01:40 UTC.

Ana: I'll post short start/mid/end updates to #incidents. Ping me if p99 >2% or error spike >1%. Starting at 00:30 UTC unless objections. :hourglass:
